title: Banke Bihari Mandir Vrindavan
style: 3D animated devotional movie style, Pixar quality, soft cinematic lighting, rich warm colours, no text, no letters, no writing
hook: Banke Bihari ka matlab kya hai?

scenes.prompt: Devotional darshan of Lord Krishna as a dark-complexioned child-like murti in graceful tribhanga pose, peacock feather crown, flute, yellow dhoti, garlands of flowers, glowing diyas, warm golden temple interior
scenes.tts: वृंदावन के बाँके बिहारी जी! नाम का अर्थ जानते हैं?
scenes.sub: Vrindavan ke Banke Bihari ji! Naam ka arth jaante hain?
scenes.animate: a very slow gentle camera push-in, the face stays still and serene, the soft golden glow gently pulses, a few marigold petals drift in the foreground

scenes.prompt: Close view of Lord Krishna murti standing with body bent gracefully in three places, flute at his lips, peacock feather, surrounded by flower garlands and lamp light, serene devotional mood
scenes.tts: बाँके यानी त्रिभंगी मुद्रा, तीन जगह से मुड़ी, मान्यता है।
scenes.sub: Banke yaani teen jagah se mudi tribhangi mudra, aisa maana jaata hai.
scenes.animate: the camera drifts very slowly sideways, the face stays still and serene, diya flames flicker softly, a few petals fall gently

scenes.prompt: Saint Swami Haridas sitting in a peaceful sacred grove at dawn in Vrindavan, tulsi trees, singing devotional music with a tanpura, soft golden light through leaves, calm and devotional
scenes.tts: मान्यता है स्वामी हरिदास जी ने निधिवन में सेवा की।
scenes.sub: Manyata hai Swami Haridas ji ne Nidhivan mein seva ki.
scenes.animate: sunlight filters gently through the leaves, the leaves sway softly and the camera slowly pulls back, the saint stays calm

scenes.prompt: Peaceful devotees with folded hands in a courtyard of a Vrindavan temple in the evening, warm lamp light, marigold garlands, soft glow, people seen from behind
scenes.tts: मथुरा ज़िले का वृंदावन, श्रद्धा का धाम है।
scenes.sub: Mathura zile ka Vrindavan, shraddha ka dham hai.
scenes.animate: the lamp flames flicker softly, a few marigold petals drift down and the camera slowly pushes in

scenes.tts: जय श्री राधे! कल धनतेरस की झलक के लिए लाइक, शेयर और सब्सक्राइब करें।
scenes.sub: Jai Shree Radhe! Kal Dhanteras ki jhalak ke liye Like, Share aur Subscribe karein.
